title: Coding with OpenHands
description: OpenHands' web UI (the Agent Canvas) on your project (in the sandbox's own browser with --browser), PyPI, npm and GitHub open for the project's packages and code, the agent's memory of this project kept between sessions; everything else stays closed.

de.title: Programmieren mit OpenHands
de.description: Die Web-Oberfläche von OpenHands (der Agent Canvas) an Ihrem Projekt (im eigenen Browser der Sandbox mit --browser), PyPI, npm und GitHub offen für die Pakete und den Code des Projekts, das Gedächtnis des Agenten zu diesem Projekt bleibt zwischen den Sitzungen; alles andere bleibt zu.

notes: The model: Anthropic's API with your key (sandbox-ai secrets set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY once); OpenHands sees a placeholder, the connection proxy puts the key in on the wire, and --model names the model (LiteLLM's anthropic/...). Another provider: --api-key api.openai.com=OPENAI_API_KEY or openrouter.ai=OPENROUTER_API_KEY with its --model, or a server of yours with --llm (the preset openhands-local-llm); OpenHands has no maker's model service of its own.

OpenHands' interactive surface is the Agent Canvas, its web UI on the sandbox's loopback (http://127.0.0.1:8000/): add --browser to see it in the sandbox's own browser, which starts on it (the app's Browser button; Podman). One task without the UI: sandbox-ai openhands -- task "TASK".
PyPI, npm and GitHub are open for the project's dependencies; everything else is refused or asked (--ask). Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
Memory: ~/.openhands/skills/AGENTS.md belongs to this project only and is kept between runs (not with --no-memory); the agent keeps its notes about the project there.
OpenHands asks before risky actions (its confirmation mode with the LLM security analyzer); -D turns that off. Its automation backend is off (--openhands-enable automations).
OpenHands' telemetry is always off and cannot be turned on (its kill switches pinned, its consent recorded as denied, its hosts refused by the proxy).
OpenHands is not live-tested yet (a start says so); its image first: sandbox-ai build openhands.
